svg.title: Population-mean sensitivity to three fixed nonrespondent shifts
svg.desc: Conditional 90% posterior intervals for the population mean at nonrespondent shifts -2, 0 and 2 units, with respondent fraction fixed at 0.4. The respondent data do not identify the shift.
